title: As Retail Opportunity Investments (ROIC) Stock Declined, First Foundation Advisors Boosted Stake by $1.12 Million; Owens Ill (OI) Holder Mountain Lake Investment Management Has Trimmed Its Position
text:
As Retail Opportunity Investments (ROIC) Stock Declined, First Foundation Advisors Boosted Stake by $1.12 Million; Owens Ill (OI) Holder Mountain Lake Investment Management Has Trimmed Its Position
May 3, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Mitch Cantor decreased its stake in Owens Ill Inc (OI) by 60% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mountain Lake Investment Management Llc sold 150,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.69% with the market. The hedge fund run by Mitch Cantor held 100,000 shares of the consumer durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.22M, down from 250,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mountain Lake Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Owens Ill Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.17B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.78% or $0.56 $19.62. About 1.34M shares traded. Owens-Illinois, Inc. (NYSE:OI) has risen 6.62% uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.93% the S&P500.
First Foundation Advisors increased its stake in Retail Opportunity Investments (ROIC) by 3.18% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Foundation Advisors bought 59,138 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.39% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.92 million shares of the real estate investment trusts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $38.23M, up from 1.86M at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Foundation Advisors who had been investing in Retail Opportunity Investments for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.10B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.20% or $0.38 $16.91. About 1.87M shares traded or 33.80% up from the average. Retail Opportunity Investments Corp. (NASDAQ:ROIC) has declined 17.61% downtrending. It has underperformed by 29.16% the S&P500.
Among 13 analysts covering Retail Opportunity Investments Corp ( NASDAQ:ROIC ), 8 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 62% are positive. Retail Opportunity Investments Corp had 38 analyst reports since July 22, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Robert W. Baird maintained Retail Opportunity Investments Corp. (NASDAQ:ROIC) rating on Tuesday, March 20. Robert W. Baird has “Buy” rating and $20.0 target. KeyBanc Capital Markets maintained Retail Opportunity Investments Corp. (NASDAQ:ROIC) on Monday, October 23 with “Hold” rating. As per Tuesday, February 28, the company rating was maintained by FBR Capital. The stock of Retail Opportunity Investments Corp. (NASDAQ:ROIC) earned “Buy” rating by Jefferies on Friday, November 18. The stock of Retail Opportunity Investments Corp. (NASDAQ:ROIC) has “Buy” rating given on Monday, March 5 by RBC Capital Markets. As per Thursday, September 3, the company rating was upgraded by Raymond James. The firm has “Neutral” rating given on Wednesday, February 28 by Citigroup. The firm has “Neutral” rating given on Friday, March 16 by JP Morgan. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Monday, June 12 by Jefferies. The rating was maintained by Canaccord Genuity on Tuesday, March 15 with “Buy”.
First Foundation Advisors, which manages about $3.20 billion and $1.85 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Monsanto Co (NYSE:MON) by 16,233 shares to 32,892 shares, valued at $3.84M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 20,358 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 95,229 shares, and cut its stake in Oracle Corp (NYSE:ORCL).
Since March 15, 2018, it had 0 buys, and 1 sale for $268,762 activity.
Among 16 analysts covering Owens-Illinois Inc ( NYSE:OI ), 4 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 25% are positive. The firm has “Hold” rating by Jefferies given on Thursday, July 14. On Tuesday, October 3 the stock rating was maintained by KeyBanc Capital Markets with “Hold”. (NYSE:OI) has “Hold” rating given on Monday, April 24 by BMO Capital Markets. The stock of Owens-Illinois, Inc. (NYSE:OI) has “Hold” rating given on Tuesday, May 30 by RBC Capital Markets. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Thursday, June 15 by Jefferies.
